patch_description: The current ANSATZ_SPEC (2-shell design + appended theta_ry mixer reusing the RY parameter) regressed performance to 0.55 combined score, well below the previously validated 3-shell design (distance-1, distance-2, distance-4 CRZ shells all sharing "theta_z", with no post-entanglement RY mixer) which achieved 0.61. The extra final RY layer apparently interferes with the more limited 2-shell entangling structure, dropping train accuracy from 1.00 to 0.75. This edit reverts to the empirically superior 3-shell backbone (still only 2 distinct circuit parameters: theta_ry, theta_z) as the base to build further improvements from, since parameter count and structure quality both matter and this is the strongest known 2-parameter configuration.
